criteria.name: novelty
criteria.description: Size of the residual gap after adversarial prior-art search; 1 = core claim already shipped, 5 = no direct equivalent located

criteria.name: adoption
criteria.description: Breadth of the addressable workflow, one-command install, legible output, CI fit; 1 = niche, 5 = universal daily pain

criteria.name: implementability
criteria.description: Achievable honestly with Python 3.10 stdlib only in one session; 1 = research project, 5 = small CLI

criteria.name: falsifiability
criteria.description: Can the core claim be proven wrong by a public fixture corpus and byte-stable artifacts; 1 = unfalsifiable narrative, 5 = machine-checkable evidence

criteria.name: demoability
criteria.description: Can a stranger see the value in under 30 seconds with no setup; 1 = needs infra, 5 = one command

criteria.name: safety_burden
criteria.description: Risk of executing arbitrary commands, handling untrusted data, or leaking secrets; 1 = read-only, 5 = broad dangerous execution surface
